```sql
with with_dims as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        a.*,
        o.shipping_fee,
        o.discount,
        o.amount
    from order_items a
    left join orders o
        on a.order_id = o.id
),
joined as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.product_id,
        a.unit_price,
        a.discount,
        a.amount,
        d.product_name,
        d.category,
        d.price
    from with_dims a
    join products d
        on a.product_id = d.id
),
latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *, row_number() over (partition by product_id order by price, id) as rank_in_group
    from joined
    qualify rank_in_group = 1
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        first_value(price, true) over w_grp as first_known_price,
        lead(amount, 1) over (order by discount, id) as next_amount,
        last_value(discount, true) over (partition by category order by price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_discount
    from latest
    where discount < 0.28
    window w_grp as (partition by product_id order by rank_in_group, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        s.id,
        s.product_id,
        s.unit_price,
        s.discount,
        s.category,
        s.next_amount,
        d.brand,
        d.cost,
        d.stock_qty
    from with_windows s
    left join products d
        on s.product_id = d.id
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(cost) over (partition by product_id order by discount, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as cost_avg_5_prior,
        last_value(brand, true) over (partition by product_id order by unit_price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_brand,
        avg(discount) over (partition by category, brand) as category_avg_discount
    from enriched
)
select
    id,
    product_id,
    unit_price,
    next_amount,
    brand,
    cost_avg_5_prior,
    last_known_brand,
    category_avg_discount,
    case when brand rlike '^(Initech|Umbrella)$' then 'GROUP_A' when brand rlike '^(Acme|Globex)$' then 'CORE' else 'EXTENDED' end as brand_zone
from scored
order by brand
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_dims = (
    df_order_items
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("o.shipping_fee"), F.col("o.discount"), F.col("o.amount"))
)

joined = (
    with_dims
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.product_id",
        "a.unit_price",
        "a.discount",
        "a.amount",
        F.col("d.product_name"),
        F.col("d.category"),
        F.col("d.price"),
    )
)

latest = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("discount") < 0.28)
    .withColumn("first_known_price", F.first("price", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_amount", F.lead("amount", 1).over(Window.orderBy("discount", "id")))
    .withColumn("last_known_discount", F.last("discount", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.product_id",
        "s.unit_price",
        "s.discount",
        "s.category",
        "s.next_amount",
        F.col("d.brand"),
        F.col("d.cost"),
        F.col("d.stock_qty"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("cost_avg_5_prior"),
        F.last("brand", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_brand"),
        F.avg("discount").over(Window.partitionBy("category", "brand")).alias("category_avg_discount"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        "next_amount",
        "brand",
        "cost_avg_5_prior",
        "last_known_brand",
        "category_avg_discount",
        F.when(F.col("brand").rlike("^(Initech|Umbrella)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("brand").rlike("^(Acme|Globex)$"), "CORE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("brand_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("brand")
)
```

```sql
WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE voltage >= 218.5
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        DATE_FORMAT(read_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS read_at_label,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', read_at) AS days_since_read_at
    FROM recent
    WHERE quality IN ('EST', 'OK')
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(TRIM(read_at_label)) AS read_at_label_clean,
        CONCAT(read_at_label, '#', CAST(days_since_read_at AS STRING)) AS read_at_label_ref
    FROM enriched
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        kwh,
        days_since_read_at,
        read_at_label_clean,
        read_at_label_ref,
        LAST_VALUE(voltage) OVER (ORDER BY voltage DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_voltage,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_voltage_ties AS voltage_dense_rank
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_all_by_voltage_ties AS (ORDER BY voltage DESC)
),
scored_2 AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(read_at_label_ref), ' ', '_')) AS read_at_label_ref_slug
    FROM with_trends
    WHERE kwh > 46.6
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        kwh,
        days_since_read_at,
        last_voltage,
        voltage_dense_rank,
        read_at_label_ref_slug,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_voltage_dense_rank AS rows_in_voltage_dense_rank,
        ROUND(voltage_dense_rank / NULLIF(SUM(voltage_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY voltage_dense_rank), 0), 4) AS voltage_dense_rank_share_of_voltage_dense_rank,
        MIN(days_since_read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY voltage_dense_rank ORDER BY voltage_dense_rank DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_days_since_read_at_so_far,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY voltage_dense_rank ORDER BY voltage_dense_rank DESC), 3) AS voltage_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        ROUND(last_voltage / NULLIF(SUM(last_voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY voltage_dense_rank), 0), 4) AS last_voltage_share_of_voltage_dense_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(last_voltage) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY voltage_dense_rank ORDER BY voltage_dense_rank DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_last_voltage
    FROM scored_2
    WINDOW w_voltage_dense_rank AS (PARTITION BY voltage_dense_rank)
),
leaders AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT
        id,
        kwh,
        days_since_read_at,
        last_voltage,
        read_at_label_ref_slug,
        rows_in_voltage_dense_rank,
        voltage_dense_rank_share_of_voltage_dense_rank,
        min_days_since_read_at_so_far,
        voltage_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        last_voltage_share_of_voltage_dense_rank,
        last_known_last_voltage
    FROM ranked
    WHERE voltage_dense_rank = 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    kwh,
    days_since_read_at,
    last_voltage,
    read_at_label_ref_slug,
    rows_in_voltage_dense_rank,
    voltage_dense_rank_share_of_voltage_dense_rank,
    min_days_since_read_at_so_far,
    last_voltage_share_of_voltage_dense_rank,
    last_known_last_voltage,
    LENGTH(TRIM(read_at_label_ref_slug)) AS read_at_label_ref_slug_len
FROM leaders
ORDER BY last_voltage, last_voltage_share_of_voltage_dense_rank
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("voltage") >= 218.5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
    )
)

enriched = (
    recent
    .filter(F.col("quality").isin("EST", "OK"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        F.date_format(F.col("read_at"), "MMM yyyy").alias("read_at_label"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("read_at")).alias("days_since_read_at"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("read_at_label"))).alias("read_at_label_clean"),
        F.concat(F.col("read_at_label"), F.lit("#"), F.col("days_since_read_at").cast("string")).alias("read_at_label_ref"),
    )
)

w_all_by_voltage_ties = Window.orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc())
with_trends = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh",
        "days_since_read_at",
        "read_at_label_clean",
        "read_at_label_ref",
        F.last("voltage").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("voltage").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_voltage"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_all_by_voltage_ties).alias("voltage_dense_rank"),
    )
)

scored_2 = (
    with_trends
    .filter(F.col("kwh") > 46.6)
    .withColumn("read_at_label_ref_slug", F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("read_at_label_ref")), " ", "_")))
)

w_voltage_dense_rank = Window.partitionBy("voltage_dense_rank")
ranked = (
    scored_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh",
        "days_since_read_at",
        "last_voltage",
        "voltage_dense_rank",
        "read_at_label_ref_slug",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_voltage_dense_rank).alias("rows_in_voltage_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("voltage_dense_rank") / F.nullif(F.sum("voltage_dense_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_dense_rank")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("voltage_dense_rank_share_of_voltage_dense_rank"),
        F.min("days_since_read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_dense_rank").orderBy(F.col("voltage_dense_rank").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_days_since_read_at_so_far"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_dense_rank").orderBy(F.col("voltage_dense_rank").desc())), 3).alias("voltage_dense_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("last_voltage") / F.nullif(F.sum("last_voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_dense_rank")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("last_voltage_share_of_voltage_dense_rank"),
        F.last("last_voltage", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("voltage_dense_rank").orderBy(F.col("voltage_dense_rank").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_last_voltage"),
    )
)

leaders = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("voltage_dense_rank") == 1)
    .drop("voltage_dense_rank")
)

result = (
    leaders
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh",
        "days_since_read_at",
        "last_voltage",
        "read_at_label_ref_slug",
        "rows_in_voltage_dense_rank",
        "voltage_dense_rank_share_of_voltage_dense_rank",
        "min_days_since_read_at_so_far",
        "last_voltage_share_of_voltage_dense_rank",
        "last_known_last_voltage",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("read_at_label_ref_slug"))).alias("read_at_label_ref_slug_len"),
    )
    .orderBy("last_voltage", "last_voltage_share_of_voltage_dense_rank")
)
```

```sql
WITH matched AS (SELECT o.id, o.channel, o.amount, o.discount FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM accounts a WHERE a.account_type <> 'CREDIT' AND a.opened_date < DATE_SUB(o.order_date, 7) AND a.customer_id IS NOT NULL) AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, ROUND(AVG(discount), 2) AS avg_discount FROM matched GROUP BY channel ORDER BY avg_discount;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(
        df_accounts.filter(F.col("account_type") != "CREDIT").filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull()).alias("a"),
        (F.col("o.customer_id") == F.col("a.customer_id"))
        & (F.col("a.opened_date") < F.date_sub(F.col("o.order_date"), 7)),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .filter(F.col("o.customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(F.col("o.id"), F.col("o.channel"), F.col("o.amount"), F.col("o.discount"))
)

result = (
    matched
    .groupBy("channel")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n"),
        F.sum(F.col("amount")).alias("total_amount"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("discount")), 2).alias("avg_discount"),
    )
    .orderBy("avg_discount")
)
```

```sql
    session_no,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    duration_min,
    quality_ref,
    session_no_distance,
    COALESCE(session_no_distance, 0) AS session_no_distance_filled
FROM enriched
WHERE session_no <= 5
ORDER BY quality_ref DESC NULLS FIRST, session_no_distance
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("kwh") > 51.5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.round(F.col("voltage") / F.nullif(F.col("kwh"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("voltage_per_kwh"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid_readings.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("quality", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("read_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("read_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    per_session
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat(F.col("quality"), F.lit("#"), F.col("session_no").cast("string")).alias("quality_ref"),
        F.abs(F.col("session_no") - 4).alias("session_no_distance"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("session_no") <= 5)
    .select(
        "quality",
        "session_no",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "duration_min",
        "quality_ref",
        "session_no_distance",
        F.coalesce(F.col("session_no_distance"), F.lit(0)).alias("session_no_distance_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quality_ref").desc_nulls_first(), "session_no_distance")
)
```

```python
w_recent = Window.orderBy("running_amount_scaled", "id")
w_recent_2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("running_amount").desc_nulls_first())

enriched = (
    df_payments
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("e.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.amount") > 820)
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.order_id",
        "e.method",
        "e.amount",
        "e.paid_at",
        F.col("d.status").alias("order_status"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        F.sum("amount").over(Window.orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_amount"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("order_status"))), 4).alias("amount_share"),
        F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("paid_at")).orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_amount"),
        F.lag("amount", 2).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("paid_at"), "method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("amount_share") < 0.27)
    .withColumn("running_amount_scaled", F.round((F.col("running_amount") * 1.1), 2))
)

scored_payments = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("event_seq_2", F.row_number().over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("running_amount_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_recent_2))
    .withColumn("prev_amount_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("prev_amount", "id")))
)

cleaned = (
    scored_payments
    .filter(F.col("cumulative_amount") == 7051)
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "cumulative_amount",
        "amount_share",
        "prev_amount",
        "event_seq",

    )
)

with_windows = (

    .withColumn("last_known_prev_amount", F.last("prev_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("prev_amount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("first_known_cumulative_amount", F.first("cumulative_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

    .filter(F.col("method").isNotNull() & F.col("greatest_running_amount_scaled_cumulative_amount").between(31, 36))

        F.round((F.col("cumulative_amount") / F.col("prev_amount")), 2).alias("cumulative_amount_per_prev_amount"),
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY track_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

per_session AS (

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    FROM flagged
```

```sql
per_session AS (

        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(ms_played) AS session_ms_played,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY track_id, burst_id
)
SELECT
    track_id,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min,
    YEAR(session_end) AS session_end_year
```

```python
    .filter((F.col("read_at") < F.lit("2025-03-02 09:00:00").cast("timestamp")) | (F.col("kwh") >= 20.4))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        F.to_date(F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_date"),
    )
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY quality, session_no
)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

        burst_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, burst_id
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_end) AS session_end_month,
        n_events,
        ROUND(SUM(duration_min), 2) AS total_duration_min,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id, 0.5) AS median_burst_id,
        MAX(session_start) AS last_session_start,
        SUM(n_events) AS total_n_events,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_min, 0.5) AS median_duration_min
    FROM sessions

-- Final projection

    n_events,
    median_burst_id,
    last_session_start,
    total_n_events,
    median_duration_min,
    CASE WHEN median_burst_id >= 5 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN median_burst_id >= 3 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS median_burst_id_tier
FROM rollup_base
ORDER BY session_end_month NULLS LAST, total_n_events
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_tickets
    .filter(F.to_date(F.col("opened_at")) < F.lit("2025-02-12").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "tags",
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("channel"))).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_opened_at", F.lag("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | (F.col("opened_at") > F.col("prev_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("opened_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (

    )

result = (

        "n_events",
        "median_burst_id",
        "last_session_start",
        "total_n_events",
        "median_duration_min",
        F.when(F.col("median_burst_id") >= 5, "HIGH").when(F.col("median_burst_id") >= 3, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("median_burst_id_tier"),
```

```python
    df_app_logs
    .select(
```

```python
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",

    flattened
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("log_ts") - F.lag("log_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))

        "id",
        "attr_key",

    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("last_known_new_group_flag_2").over(Window.orderBy("last_known_new_group_flag", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_last_known_new_group_flag_2"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last_known_new_group_flag").desc(), "id", "attr_key")).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.sum("last_known_new_group_flag_2").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key")).alias("attr_key_sum_last_known_new_group_flag_2"),
        F.avg("seq_no").over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("last_known_new_group_flag_2", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)).alias("seq_no_avg_5"),

        "seq_no_avg_5",

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id", "attr_key")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.first("last_known_new_group_flag_2", ignorenulls=True).over(w_part).alias("first_known_last_known_new_group_flag_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("seq_no_3"),
        F.lag("last_known_new_group_flag_2", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("seq_no_avg_5", "id", "attr_key")).alias("prev_last_known_new_group_flag_2"),
    )

scored = (

        "attr_key",

        "cumulative_last_known_new_group_flag_2",
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY ticket_id, burst_id
),
scored AS (
```

```python
        "event_type",
        "actor",

flagged = (
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claim_type,
        claimed_amount,
        approved_amount,
        status,
        reported_at
    FROM claims
    WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'APPROVED')
)
SELECT
    'claim' AS record_type,
    adjuster_id,
    claimed_amount,
    claim_date AS event_date
FROM recent
WHERE MONTH(reported_at) IN (1, 3)
  AND claimed_amount <= 34401.0
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'policy' AS record_type,
    holder_id AS adjuster_id,
    premium AS claimed_amount,
    end_date AS event_date
FROM policies
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'holder' AS record_type,
    id AS adjuster_id,
    risk_score AS claimed_amount,
    joined_on AS event_date
FROM policyholders
ORDER BY claimed_amount, adjuster_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status").isin("OPEN", "IN_REVIEW", "APPROVED"))

        "adjuster_id",
        "claim_date",
        "claim_type",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "status",
        "reported_at",
    )
)

claim_rows = (
    recent
    .filter((F.month(F.col("reported_at")).isin(1, 3)) & (F.col("claimed_amount") <= 34401.0))

        F.lit("claim").alias("record_type"),
        "adjuster_id",
        "claimed_amount",
        F.col("claim_date").alias("event_date"),

        F.col("premium").alias("claimed_amount"),

        F.col("risk_score").alias("claimed_amount"),
        F.col("joined_on").alias("event_date"),

)

result = (
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(event_type), 1, 3) AS event_type_prefix
    FROM ticket_events
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per ticket_id
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_event_at)) / 60 > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY ticket_id, burst_id
)
SELECT
    ticket_id,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'yyyy-MM') AS session_end_label,
    ROUND(burst_id / NULLIF(duration_min, 0), 3) AS burst_id_per_duration_min
FROM sessions
ORDER BY session_end DESC NULLS FIRST, burst_id, ticket_id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("event_type")), 1, 3).alias("event_type_prefix"),
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_event_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("ticket_id", "burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "ticket_id",
        "burst_id",
        "session_start",
        "session_end",
        "events",
        F.date_format(F.col("session_end"), "yyyy-MM").alias("session_end_label"),
        F.round(F.col("burst_id") / F.nullif(F.col("duration_min"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("burst_id_per_duration_min"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("session_end").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("burst_id").asc(),
        "ticket_id",
    )
    .limit(20)
)
```

```python
        F.min("greatest_claimed_amount_approved_amount").alias("min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved_amount"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count(F.when(~F.col("claim_status").isin("OPEN", "IN_REVIEW"), 1)).alias("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    per_group
    .crossJoin(per_group.agg(F.min("min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved_amount").alias("overall_min_min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved")))
    .filter(F.col("min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved_amount") > F.col("overall_min_min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved"))
    .drop("overall_min_min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved")
)

w_claim_date_year_by_n_claim_s = Window.partitionBy("claim_date_year").orderBy(F.col("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in").desc())
with_trends = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "claim_date_year",
        "claim_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "n_rows",
        "total_claim_approved_amount",
        "min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved_amount",
        "n_claim_status_not_in_open_in",
        F.sum("n_rows").over(Window.partitionBy("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in", "claim_date_year").orderBy("distinct_ids", "claim_date_year", "claim_id", "adjuster_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_n_rows"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in", "claim_date_year").orderBy("distinct_ids")).alias("distinct_ids_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_claim_date_year_by_n_claim_s), 3).alias("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("total_claim_approved_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in", "claim_date_year").orderBy("distinct_ids", "claim_date_year", "claim_id", "adjuster_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_total_claim_approved_amount"),
        F.max("n_rows").over(Window.partitionBy("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in", "claim_date_year").orderBy("distinct_ids", "claim_date_year", "claim_id", "adjuster_id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("n_rows_max_3"),
        F.sum("claim_date_year").over(Window.partitionBy("n_claim_status_not_in_open_in", "claim_date_year").orderBy("distinct_ids", "claim_date_year", "claim_id", "adjuster_id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("claim_date_year_sum_4"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .filter(F.col("claim_id") <= 90)
    .select(
        "claim_date_year",
        "claim_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "total_claim_approved_amount",
        "min_greatest_claimed_amount_approved_amount",
        "n_claim_status_not_in_open_in",
        "running_n_rows",
        "distinct_ids_rank",
        "n_rows_max_3",
        "claim_date_year_sum_4",
    )
)
```
